entries.name: The Fool
entries.keywordsText: new beginnings, freedom, adventure, innocence, foolishness
entries.fortuneText: There is a free, excited feeling of wanting to start something new without fear.

entries.name: The Fool
entries.keywordsText: new beginnings, freedom, adventure, innocence, foolishness
entries.fortuneText: If you are weighing everything too carefully, take a light first step today without overthinking it.

entries.name: The Magician
entries.keywordsText: putting ideas into action, planning, getting started, creation, using resources
entries.fortuneText: Your resources and will come together, giving you the ability to make an intention real.

entries.name: The Magician
entries.keywordsText: putting ideas into action, planning, getting started, creation, using resources
entries.fortuneText: If you have only been turning ideas over, put at least one of them into action today.

entries.name: The High Priestess
entries.keywordsText: intuition, mystery, secrets, silence, truth, inner life
entries.fortuneText: Inner signals become clearer than words, and your intuition is working well.

entries.name: The High Priestess
entries.keywordsText: intuition, mystery, secrets, silence, truth, inner life
entries.fortuneText: If you are rushing for an answer, pause and listen to your intuition today.

entries.name: The Empress
entries.keywordsText: abundance, motherhood, care, creativity, the senses
entries.fortuneText: A warm, generous impulse to care and cultivate makes this a good time to help something grow.

entries.name: The Empress
entries.keywordsText: abundance, motherhood, care, creativity, the senses
entries.fortuneText: If you have neglected yourself, give yourself plenty of care today.

entries.name: The Emperor
entries.fortuneText: Your foundations and sense of order are firm, making it a good time to take charge.

entries.name: The Emperor
entries.fortuneText: If things feel disorganized, establish a structure and put them in order today.

entries.name: The Hierophant
entries.fortuneText: A familiar method or trustworthy advice fits better than pushing ahead alone.

entries.name: The Hierophant
entries.fortuneText: If you feel lost, ask for advice or revisit the basics today instead of struggling alone.

entries.name: The Lovers
entries.fortuneText: Feelings and relationships come together warmly, and your choices tend to follow your heart.

entries.name: The Lovers
entries.fortuneText: If something feels out of step, choose honestly in the direction your heart takes you today.

entries.name: The Chariot
entries.fortuneText: Scattered energies come together in one direction, giving you the momentum to push ahead.

entries.name: The Chariot
entries.fortuneText: If your resolve is scattered, focus on one goal and press forward today.

entries.name: Strength
entries.keywordsText: courage, confidence, gentle strength, self-control, ease
entries.fortuneText: You have the strength to hold steady with gentleness and resolve, without forcing your way through.

entries.name: Strength
entries.keywordsText: courage, confidence, gentle strength, self-control, ease
entries.fortuneText: If you feel impatient, ease your grip and handle things gently today.

entries.name: The Hermit
entries.keywordsText: reflection, solitude, replenishment, inner life, quiet
entries.fortuneText: You step back from outside noise and quietly search for answers on your own.

entries.name: The Hermit
entries.keywordsText: reflection, solitude, replenishment, inner life, quiet
entries.fortuneText: If you have lacked time alone, make room today to look inward in peace.

entries.name: Wheel of Fortune
entries.keywordsText: good fortune, a turning point, flow, opportunity, change
entries.fortuneText: A stalled situation begins to move, bringing unexpected luck and a change of direction.

entries.name: Wheel of Fortune
entries.keywordsText: good fortune, a turning point, flow, opportunity, change
entries.fortuneText: If you are stuck in a pattern, try moving with the changing current today.

entries.name: Justice
entries.fortuneText: As the facts and standards become clear, things settle into a fair balance.

entries.name: Justice
entries.fortuneText: If you have been putting something off, weigh the facts and make a decision today.

entries.name: The Hanged Man
entries.keywordsText: pause, frustration, a change of perspective, a reversal in thinking, insight
entries.fortuneText: A pause lets you see the same situation differently, bringing an unexpected realization.

entries.name: The Hanged Man
entries.keywordsText: pause, frustration, a change of perspective, a reversal in thinking, insight
entries.fortuneText: If you feel trapped and frustrated, step back and turn your perspective around today.

entries.name: Death
entries.keywordsText: endings, difficult change, transition, letting go, a fresh start
entries.fortuneText: An ending or a difficult change may be approaching. Let it pass instead of holding on; the sun rises on the other side.

entries.name: Death
entries.keywordsText: endings, difficult change, transition, letting go, a fresh start
entries.fortuneText: There is no avoiding the hard part. The quickest way through is to face it directly.

entries.name: Temperance
entries.fortuneText: Different things blend in the right proportions, finding a balance of neither too much nor too little.

entries.name: Temperance
entries.fortuneText: If you have leaned too far in one direction, reduce the excess and restore balance today.

entries.name: The Devil
entries.keywordsText: desire, attachment, captivity, addiction, illusion, anxiety
entries.fortuneText: Desire and attachment can easily take hold. Look at what you are tied to right now.

entries.name: The Devil
entries.keywordsText: desire, attachment, captivity, addiction, illusion, anxiety
entries.fortuneText: If you are wavering or worrying about what others think, let yourself go for what you want today.

entries.name: The Tower
entries.fortuneText: What you have built may shake or fall apart. This is a time to let go rather than hold on by force.

entries.name: The Tower
entries.fortuneText: If you are clinging to something that is not working, clear it away and start over today.

entries.name: The Star
entries.fortuneText: Like the calm after a storm, recovery comes gently and hope begins to return.

entries.name: The Star
entries.fortuneText: If you are worn out, ask less of yourself and take time to recover today.

entries.name: The Moon
entries.keywordsText: instinct, dreams, imagination, primal feelings, the unconscious
entries.fortuneText: Instinct and imagination grow stronger, and the path may feel a little unclear.

entries.name: The Moon
entries.keywordsText: instinct, dreams, imagination, primal feelings, the unconscious
entries.fortuneText: If you are reasoning everything out, listen to your intuition, dreams, and inner feelings today.

entries.name: The Sun
entries.keywordsText: vitality, joy, happiness, satisfaction, success, brightness
entries.fortuneText: Things become clear and go well, bringing a welcome surge of energy.

entries.name: The Sun
entries.keywordsText: vitality, joy, happiness, satisfaction, success, brightness
entries.fortuneText: If your energy is low, fill today with things that lift your spirits, however small.

entries.name: Judgement
entries.keywordsText: judgement, taking stock, assessment, rebirth, a calling
entries.fortuneText: This is a good time to look back, assess what happened, acknowledge what needs reflection, and move to the next stage.

entries.name: Judgement
entries.keywordsText: judgement, taking stock, assessment, rebirth, a calling
entries.fortuneText: If you have put off a decision, look back and bring it to a close today.

entries.name: The World
entries.fortuneText: A full cycle reaches completion, bringing a satisfying sense of closure.

entries.name: The World
entries.fortuneText: If something remains unfinished, tie up the last loose end and complete it today.

entries.name: Ace of Pentacles
entries.keywordsText: material things, money, abundance, a practical opportunity
entries.fortuneText: A tangible opportunity, money, or resources arrive, bringing a welcome practical gain.

entries.name: Ace of Pentacles
entries.keywordsText: material things, money, abundance, a practical opportunity
entries.fortuneText: If you are letting an opportunity drift past, take hold of the resources before you today.

entries.name: Two of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: You weigh practical demands that do not fit together easily, working out your priorities.

entries.name: Two of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: If treating everything equally has become too much to carry, set priorities and restore balance today.

entries.name: Three of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: You coordinate roles and learn with others, building results together.

entries.name: Three of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: If you are holding onto the work alone, join a collaborative setting to learn and exchange ideas today.

entries.name: Four of Pentacles
entries.keywordsText: attachment, clutching, fear of letting go, compulsion
entries.fortuneText: Fear of losing what you have can make you grip it too tightly.

entries.name: Four of Pentacles
entries.keywordsText: attachment, clutching, fear of letting go, compulsion
entries.fortuneText: If you keep being swayed into giving things away, hold firm to your share and your boundaries today.

entries.name: Five of Pentacles
entries.keywordsText: hardship, needing help, scarcity, nearby support
entries.fortuneText: Practical life feels hard today. There may be somewhere nearby to turn for help that you have overlooked.

entries.name: Five of Pentacles
entries.keywordsText: hardship, needing help, scarcity, nearby support
entries.fortuneText: Even if there is no one to lean on and you feel lost, keep walking on your own feet today instead of giving up.

entries.name: Six of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: You give and receive with a clear basis, sharing in balance rather than giving everything away.

entries.name: Six of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: If you are giving indiscriminately or clutching everything, weigh things up and establish a basis for sharing today.

entries.name: Seven of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: What you have tended is ripening. This is a good time to wait without rushing it.

entries.name: Seven of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: If you are hurrying the outcome, trust what has accumulated and give it another moment today.

entries.name: Eight of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: Quietly practicing and refining the same work, you build skill and results over time.

entries.name: Eight of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: If you are only looking for shortcuts or one big break, return to diligent repetition today.

entries.name: Nine of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: This is a good time to enjoy the abundance and results you have built, at your leisure.

entries.name: Nine of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: If enough still feels like too little, recognize and enjoy what your efforts have already produced today.

entries.name: Ten of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: Plenty and stability are firmly established in daily life.

entries.name: Ten of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: If you cannot see the foundations you have, take stock of the abundance and stability around you today.

entries.name: Page of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: Learning and small joys shine in the things around you.

entries.name: Page of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: If you have been brushing off small pleasures, enjoy learning about the one thing in your hands today.

entries.name: Knight of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: Though progress is slow, quiet and diligent effort builds something real, piece by piece.

entries.name: Knight of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: If you are only chasing visible speed, keep steadily at the same work today.

entries.name: Queen of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: You tend to abundance and happiness in practical ways, enjoying them comfortably.

entries.name: Queen of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: If you have only been storing things up, put them into a form you can use in everyday life today.

entries.name: King of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: Dependable stability and abundance settle into place, strengthening your foundations.

entries.name: King of Pentacles
entries.fortuneText: If your foundations are shaky, calmly tend to your resources and build a solid base today.

entries.name: Ace of Wands
entries.fortuneText: Fresh passion comes into your hands, bringing the urge to start something.

entries.name: Ace of Wands
entries.fortuneText: If you are only waiting for motivation, kindle one small interest today.

entries.name: Two of Wands
entries.fortuneText: From what you have already achieved, you look toward more distant possibilities and a new arena.

entries.name: Two of Wands
entries.fortuneText: If you are staying within familiar achievements, explore new ground beyond them today.

entries.name: Three of Wands
entries.fortuneText: Work that has reached outward is beginning to show visible achievement.

entries.name: Three of Wands
entries.fortuneText: If you feel you have achieved nothing, notice what has already extended outward and where it is heading today.

entries.name: Four of Wands
entries.fortuneText: A good result has arrived. Let yourself celebrate and enjoy it fully.

entries.name: Four of Wands
entries.fortuneText: If you passed over something good, give yourself room today to enjoy what deserves celebration.

entries.name: Five of Wands
entries.fortuneText: Friction with people or circumstances can lead to heated exchanges.

entries.name: Five of Wands
entries.fortuneText: If you are avoiding even necessary clashes, take the courage to join healthy competition today.

entries.name: Six of Wands
entries.fortuneText: Your victory is visible, and the achievement receives proper recognition.

entries.name: Six of Wands
entries.fortuneText: If you are belittling your own win, acknowledge it clearly and move forward today.

entries.name: Seven of Wands
entries.fortuneText: Even with opposition and pushback, you defend your position and hold on.

entries.name: Seven of Wands
entries.fortuneText: If pressure is pushing you back, establish your position and hold it as long as needed today.

entries.name: Eight of Wands
entries.fortuneText: Energy gathers in one direction, and things move forward quickly.

entries.name: Eight of Wands
entries.fortuneText: If things have stopped flowing, spend less time thinking and pick up the pace today.

entries.name: Nine of Wands
entries.fortuneText: Even under outside pressure, you establish a defense and hold your position to the end.

entries.name: Nine of Wands
entries.fortuneText: If broken boundaries have left you pushed back, draw the line you need to protect again today.

entries.name: Ten of Wands
entries.fortuneText: You are carrying a great deal, and the strain and pressure feel heavy.

entries.name: Ten of Wands
entries.fortuneText: If you are pretending the burden is not there, acknowledge its weight and carry it in smaller loads today.

entries.name: Page of Wands
entries.fortuneText: Curiosity wakes up, making you want to explore something new.

entries.name: Page of Wands
entries.fortuneText: If you are holding only to the familiar, follow one fresh curiosity today, even awkwardly.

entries.name: Knight of Wands
entries.fortuneText: Adventure and passion take the lead, making you want to charge straight ahead.

entries.name: Knight of Wands
entries.fortuneText: If you have stopped at calculating everything, put your passion behind one bold move today.

entries.name: Queen of Wands
entries.fortuneText: Assurance, confidence, and an attractive presence come through naturally.

entries.name: Queen of Wands
entries.fortuneText: If you have been hiding yourself, show your confidence and stand tall today.

entries.name: King of Wands
entries.fortuneText: Belief in yourself extends outward as charisma and leadership.

entries.name: King of Wands
entries.fortuneText: If you lack confidence in leading, choose a direction, take responsibility, and step forward today.

entries.name: Ace of Cups
entries.keywordsText: emotion, the heart, natural flow, fullness
entries.fortuneText: Your heart opens, and things move as naturally as flowing water.

entries.name: Ace of Cups
entries.keywordsText: emotion, the heart, natural flow, fullness
entries.fortuneText: If forcing things is closing off your feelings, open your heart and accept the flow today.

entries.name: Two of Cups
entries.fortuneText: Like two cups raised together, your feelings meet and you share with pleasure.

entries.name: Two of Cups
entries.fortuneText: If you have kept your feelings to yourself, offer them today and find a point of connection.

entries.name: Three of Cups
entries.fortuneText: Good feelings spread between people, with celebration and pleasure passing back and forth.

entries.name: Three of Cups
entries.fortuneText: If you are letting joyful moments pass alone, join others and share them today.

entries.name: Four of Cups
entries.keywordsText: stagnation, boredom, weariness, an unseen opportunity
entries.fortuneText: Your feelings are dull and weary, making it easy to miss an opportunity being offered.

entries.name: Four of Cups
entries.keywordsText: stagnation, boredom, weariness, an unseen opportunity
entries.fortuneText: If chasing fresh stimulation keeps pulling you from one thing to another, settle down and focus on what you have today, even if it feels boring.

entries.name: Five of Cups
entries.keywordsText: disappointment, frustration, lost motivation, what remains
entries.fortuneText: Your attention is caught by the fallen cups, making it easy to miss what remains.

entries.name: Five of Cups
entries.keywordsText: disappointment, frustration, lost motivation, what remains
entries.fortuneText: If you are pretending to be fine, let yourself feel disappointed and acknowledge the fallen cups first.

entries.name: Six of Cups
entries.fortuneText: Affection flows naturally into small acts of giving.

entries.name: Six of Cups
entries.fortuneText: If your heart has grown dry and calculating, bring back warmth through a small act of generosity today.

entries.name: Seven of Cups
entries.fortuneText: With so many ideas and possibilities, your heart can easily pull in several directions.

entries.name: Seven of Cups
entries.fortuneText: If you have closed off even the possibilities, lay them out today and choose one.

entries.name: Eight of Cups
entries.keywordsText: leaving, letting go of attachment, a deeper longing
entries.fortuneText: Even if something remains, it is time to withdraw your heart and leave in search of something deeper.

entries.name: Eight of Cups
entries.keywordsText: leaving, letting go of attachment, a deeper longing
entries.fortuneText: If lingering attachment is keeping you there, acknowledge what remains unfulfilled and leave today.

entries.name: Nine of Cups
entries.fortuneText: What you hoped for has been fulfilled, bringing satisfaction and a sense of achievement.

entries.name: Nine of Cups
entries.fortuneText: If you still feel short of something despite what you have, count what you have achieved and let yourself be satisfied today.

entries.name: Ten of Cups
entries.fortuneText: Happiness fills your everyday life with family and the people close to you.

entries.name: Ten of Cups
entries.fortuneText: If you only look far away for happiness, notice the happiness in close relationships and everyday life today.

entries.name: Page of Cups
entries.keywordsText: sensitivity, new feelings, fantasy, emotional impulses
entries.fortuneText: New feelings and sensitivity bloom like a daydream, gently stirring your heart.

entries.name: Page of Cups
entries.keywordsText: sensitivity, new feelings, fantasy, emotional impulses
entries.fortuneText: If you have been stifling your feelings, notice what is coming up today, even if it is awkward or impulsive.

entries.name: Knight of Cups
entries.fortuneText: Romance and daydreams lead the way, stirring your feelings gently.

entries.name: Knight of Cups
entries.fortuneText: If calculation has left your heart dry, carry some romance into action today, even if it spills over a little.

entries.name: Queen of Cups
entries.fortuneText: Empathy and sensitivity help you understand feelings with gentleness.

entries.name: Queen of Cups
entries.fortuneText: If you have been analyzing instead of feeling, open your sensitivity and empathize today.

entries.name: King of Cups
entries.fortuneText: You manage shifting emotions well, finding emotional steadiness and balance.

entries.name: King of Cups
entries.fortuneText: If turbulent feelings have unsettled you, regain balance today by managing them without suppressing them.

entries.name: Ace of Swords
entries.fortuneText: Your mind clears, and the essential point stands out as sharply as a blade.

entries.name: Ace of Swords
entries.fortuneText: If your judgement is clouded, bring intuition and reason to bear and cut through to one essential point today.

entries.name: Two of Swords
entries.keywordsText: defense against outside influences, inward focus, reflection, balance
entries.fortuneText: Shutting out outside noise, you focus on inner balance.

entries.name: Two of Swords
entries.keywordsText: defense against outside influences, inward focus, reflection, balance
entries.fortuneText: If outside voices are sweeping you along, turn your attention inward and reflect today.

entries.name: Three of Swords
entries.fortuneText: Acknowledging a sorrow that pierces the heart, instead of avoiding it, brings greater maturity.

entries.name: Three of Swords
entries.fortuneText: If you have been covering up pain, acknowledge the sorrow first today.

entries.name: Four of Swords
entries.keywordsText: rest, recovery, mental rest, a pause
entries.fortuneText: Busy thoughts pause for a while, leaving your mind lighter.

entries.name: Four of Swords
entries.keywordsText: rest, recovery, mental rest, a pause
entries.fortuneText: If you are overheating from the belief that more thinking will solve it, stop judging and put recovery first today.

entries.name: Five of Swords
entries.fortuneText: Trying to force a victory can cost you relationships or trust.

entries.name: Five of Swords
entries.fortuneText: If you only yield and avoid situations where you need to stand up for yourself, claim your share today in a fight you are entitled to win.

entries.name: Six of Swords
entries.fortuneText: You quietly leave a difficult place and move toward calmer conditions.

entries.name: Six of Swords
entries.fortuneText: If you are staying somewhere you need to leave, choose a way out today, even if it looks like running away.

entries.name: Seven of Swords
entries.keywordsText: strategy, an incomplete plan, careless action
entries.fortuneText: You have a strategy, but gaps in the plan make it easy to leave things behind.

entries.name: Seven of Swords
entries.keywordsText: strategy, an incomplete plan, careless action
entries.fortuneText: If you are waiting for a perfect plan, do what you can today, even with an imperfect one.

entries.name: Eight of Swords
entries.fortuneText: You feel trapped and frustrated, but a way out is actually open.

entries.name: Eight of Swords
entries.fortuneText: If you are charging ahead or struggling to break free, hold yourself back and pause cautiously today.

entries.name: Nine of Swords
entries.fortuneText: Worries and thoughts continue into the night, easily weighing on your heart.

entries.name: Nine of Swords
entries.fortuneText: If avoiding your worries has made them grow, bring out what is keeping you awake, one thing at a time today.

entries.name: Ten of Swords
entries.keywordsText: pressure, stopping, stillness, transition, a fresh start
entries.fortuneText: Pressure reaches its limit and stops; a quiet transition begins in that stillness.

entries.name: Ten of Swords
entries.keywordsText: pressure, stopping, stillness, transition, a fresh start
entries.fortuneText: If you are holding onto something that has ended, acknowledge the ending and move toward a fresh start today.

entries.name: Page of Swords
entries.fortuneText: Curiosity and vigilance come alive, making you want to understand the situation better.

entries.name: Page of Swords
entries.fortuneText: If you have simply been accepting things, take a step back to question and examine them today.

entries.name: Knight of Swords
entries.fortuneText: Once your judgement is formed, you decide at once and push ahead quickly.

entries.name: Knight of Swords
entries.fortuneText: If you keep weighing things up, make a decision and press forward today.

entries.name: Queen of Swords
entries.fortuneText: With a steady mind, you hold clearly to your own standards.

entries.name: Queen of Swords
entries.fortuneText: If wavering feelings have blurred your standards, stand calmly and firmly today.

entries.name: King of Swords
entries.fortuneText: Reason and intellect guide fair decisions, and you see the whole situation clearly enough to manage it.

entries.name: King of Swords
entries.fortuneText: If emotion or the mood around you has clouded your judgement, use reason, take a broad view, and decide today.
